The '''Shrine Restoration Initiative''' was an organization formed by [[Voss (species)|Voss]] and [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] to help restore the temples and shrines of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], destroyed after the [[Invasion of Voss]] by the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
